target_definition.soft: normalized raw vote fractions, retained as the training target
target_definition.hard: one-hot encoding of the argmax of the same raw vote fractions

selection_rule: minimum fixed-validation soft cross-entropy, then classwise soft calibration discrepancy, then earliest epoch
evaluation_policy: new evaluation pools are not loaded during training or checkpoint selection
budget_note: The registered 8-way short grid selected epochs 1-3 in every configuration. A 10-epoch feasibility attempt was stopped after the first large-training run because measured CPU cost was disproportionate; the complete paired feasibility comparison therefore uses the pre-recorded 3-epoch budget and reports this limitation.
